violations.why: irq_urchin preempts irq_yarrow between the increment and the check and resets v_falcon to 0, so the check sees a different value.
irq_urchin can run between the increment and the check and overwrite v_falcon.
The increment is a non-atomic read-modify-write. irq_urchin can write v_falcon in between, and that update is lost.
irq_urchin's write can land between the read and write of the increment and be overwritten.
irq_urchin preempts irq_grove after v_falcon=1 and sets it to 0, so the check at line 28 fails.
irq_urchin can write v_falcon between irq_grove's write and its read.
